source: Actual managed registration, mocked DSH defineTool; no tool executed
scope: Task-space arguments remain model-controlled; Dafeiyu must bind principal/identity/job to explicit space and serialize owned actions.

failure.note: Most native actions throw Error with these properties; host serialization may omit properties. ego_script returns structured failure metadata.

tools.name: ego_status
tools.description: Check whether the ego-browser CLI is usable (runs `ego-browser --status`). Use this first when other ego_* tools report "CLI not found".

tools.name: ego_auth_flush
tools.description: Force all persistent login cookies in the agent browser to be written to the on-disk profile. Call this after login (or before ending a browsing task) so the login survives a later DSH/browser restart — Chrome only flushes cookies to disk on graceful close, this nudges it to persist them now.

tools.name: ego_space_open
tools.description: Open (or reuse) an ego-lite task space in isolated sandbox mode.

tools.name: ego_space_close
tools.description: Complete (close) an ego-lite task space in sandbox mode.

name.description: Task-space name or numeric id to close.

keep.description: Keep the live page open (default false: close it).

tools.name: ego_snapshot
tools.description: Read the current page as text: the full-page semantic tree annotated with [ref=N, loc=...] selectors that ego_click / ego_fill can target. This is the main observation tool for any browser task.

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_navigate
tools.description: Open a URL in the task space, or switch to the existing tab for it. Always prefer reusing existing open tabs before opening duplicate URLs. Waits for document load. Returns resulting page info.

url.description: Absolute URL to open, e.g. https://example.com/path.

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_click
tools.description: Click an element in the current page. Target with a CSS selector, an xpath=.../loc=.../ref=N value from ego_snapshot, or viewport coordinates.

selector.description: CSS selector, xpath=..., loc=..., or ref=N from the snapshot. Required unless x/y are given.

x.description: Viewport x coordinate for a coordinate click.

y.description: Viewport y coordinate for a coordinate click.

label.description: Short human label for the action, e.g. "click submit button".

double.description: Double-click instead of single-click. Useful for opening files/rows or triggering dblclick handlers.

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_fill
tools.description: Type text into an input field. Target with a CSS selector, xpath=..., loc=..., or ref=N from ego_snapshot.

selector.description: CSS selector, xpath=..., loc=..., or ref=N for the input.

text.description: Text to type into the field.

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_js
tools.description: Evaluate a JavaScript expression in the current page and return its JSON-serializable value (e.g. "document.title", "document.querySelectorAll('a').length").

expression.description: JavaScript expression string to evaluate in the page.

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_cdp
tools.description: Issue a raw CDP command on the page target, e.g. cdp("Page.handleJavaScriptDialog", { accept: true }).

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the current page (or of a single element if selector is given). Returns the file path of the saved PNG, which you can then read with a vision/image tool.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector of an element to screenshot instead of the whole page.

path.description: Optional absolute output path for the PNG.

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_page_info
tools.description: Return the current page info: url, title, viewport size (w, h), scroll offsets (sx, sy), device metrics (pw, ph), and whether a native dialog is open. Also reports `humanCheck` — whether a CAPTCHA / human-verification challenge is detected on the page (so the agent can alert the user to complete it).

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_wait
tools.description: Pause for a fixed number of milliseconds (e.g. for animations or partial loads). For load waits prefer ego_navigate's wait option.

tools.name: ego_wait_for_selector
tools.description: Wait until an element matching a CSS selector appears (state=visible, default) or disappears (state=hidden). Use instead of a blind fixed wait when a page renders asynchronously.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to wait for, e.g. '.results' or '[data-id=done]'.

timeout.description: How long to wait in ms (default 10000).

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_wait_for_url
tools.description: Wait until the page navigates to a URL matching a substring / glob / regex. Use to catch login redirects or pagination. IMPORTANT: it only observes navigations that happen DURING this call — if the navigation already finished in a previous ego_* call, read ego_page_info instead. Matching is Playwright semantics: a full URL or a ** glob ("**/search**"); a bare substring does not match. The result always carries the current URL.

timeout.description: How long to wait in ms (default 10000).

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_wait_for_response
tools.description: Wait for a network response matching a URL/glob/regex and return it. Optionally return the body (text or JSON) — ideal for scraping API responses or confirming a submission. It only observes responses that arrive DURING this call: trigger the request and wait in the same ego_script. On timeout the result carries the current URL and a hint instead of throwing.

timeout.description: How long to wait in ms (default 10000).

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_key
tools.description: Press a keyboard key or shortcut combination on the current page, e.g. 'Enter', 'Tab', 'Control+a', 'Escape', 'ArrowDown'. Useful for forms, shortcuts and navigation. Pass `text` to type a string of characters instead (keyboard.type).

key.description: Key or combo: 'Enter', 'Tab', 'Control+c', 'Meta+v', 'ArrowDown', 'Escape', 'F5', etc. (ignored when `text` is given).

text.description: Type this text character-by-character (keyboard.type). Use instead of `key` for typing words into the focused element.

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_hover
tools.description: Move the pointer over an element (CSS selector / ref) or to viewport coordinates. Triggers CSS :hover, dropdowns and mouseenter handlers.

selector.description: CSS selector, xpath=..., loc=..., or ref=N for the element.

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_read_element
tools.description: Read a single element (by selector): its text, HTML, input value, an attribute, or visibility/enabled/count. Cheaper and more precise than a full-page snapshot.

selector.description: CSS selector of the target element.

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_select
tools.description: Choose an option in a <select> dropdown by value, label, or index (a single value or an array for multi-select).

value.description: The option: a string value/label, or {value:'..'}, {label:'..'}, {index:n}, or an array of these for multi-select.

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_drag
tools.description: Drag an element to a target (Playwright dragTo) or drag the pointer through coordinates. Use for sliders, sortable rows, and drag-drop zones.

from.description: CSS selector of the element to drag from.

to.description: CSS selector of the drop target (used with from).

points.description: Alternative: a flat list of [x1,y1,x2,y2,...] viewport coordinates to drag the mouse through.

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page: by pixel deltas (wheel), or bring an element into view (scrollIntoView).

selector.description: CSS selector to scroll into view (primary if given).

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_upload
tools.description: Set files on a file <input> element (path-driven). Use to upload a dataset/attachment from a local path.

selector.description: CSS selector of the <input type=file> element.

path.description: Absolute path of the file(s) to upload on this machine.

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_download
tools.description: Wait for a file download triggered by the current action, then return its saved path. Provide `triggerSelector` (a download button/link to click) or `triggerScript` (arbitrary JS that triggers the download). The file is captured into a temp dir and (optionally) copied to `savePath`. Returns { path, suggestedFilename, url }.

triggerSelector.description: CSS selector of the element (button/link) whose click starts the download.

triggerScript.description: Full JS snippet that triggers the download (e.g. window.open() or a fetch-to-blob download); runs in the page before waiting for the download.

savePath.description: Optional absolute destination path to also copy the downloaded file to. Otherwise only the temp-captured path is returned.

timeout.description: How long to wait for the download in ms (default 30000).

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_check
tools.description: Check (tick) or uncheck a checkbox/radio element. Does nothing if already in the desired state.

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_dialog
tools.description: Accept or dismiss a native browser dialog (alert/confirm/prompt), optionally supplying text for a prompt. This tool only reaches a dialog that is blocking the page RIGHT NOW — a dialog fired by an earlier ego_* call has already been auto-dismissed across the call boundary. To accept a dialog triggered by a click, do both in one call: page.once("dialog", d => d.accept()); await page.click(selector). If a dialog is blocking the page, page.evaluate/snapshot calls hang until it is handled.

text.description: Text to type into a prompt dialog.

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_http
tools.description: Make an HTTP request and return status + body. Default runs in the agent page's browser context (cross-origin allowed when the server's CORS permits); set `mode: server` to use Node-side fetch.server. Use to scrape an API, POST data, or hit a service. (Note: on the vendored ego-linux Windows runtime, fetch.server can hit a libuv crash, so prefer the default browser mode there.)

mode.description: 'browser' (default) runs via the page context; 'server' uses Node-side fetch.server.

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the most recently opened or explicitly selected space.

tools.name: ego_cli
tools.description: Escape hatch: run an arbitrary `ego-browser nodejs` heredoc script verbatim (facades page/browser/taskSpaces/site/fetch and the raw cdp() are preloaded). Use when the structured ego_* tools do not cover the task. Returns raw stdout plus the parsed console.log payload when present.

script.description: Full JS script body for the heredoc; ego-browser helpers are preloaded. End with console.log('@@DSH_RESULT@@' + JSON.stringify({...})) — the literal @@DSH_RESULT@@ sentinel is required. (A trailing plain JSON line is accepted as a fallback, with result.fallback=true.)

tools.name: ego_captcha
tools.description: Check the current page for a human-verification (CAPTCHA) challenge — reCAPTCHA / hCaptcha / Cloudflare / Turnstile — and return { detected, kind }. If detected=true, ALERT THE USER that they must complete the verification in the 'ego lite - agent' browser window (it is the same live session shown in the watch panel), then continue after they have.

space.description: Task-space name or numeric id; defaults to the configured defaultSpace.

tools.name: ego_help
tools.description: Query the built-in ego-browser tool guide. `topic` may be a category (overview/tools/navigate/observe/input/keyboard-mouse/form/wait/network/login/script/doctor) or a specific tool name (e.g. ego_click). Returns the matching usage notes. Call this when unsure which eyebrow tool to use.

topic.description: Category or tool name to look up; omitted/all returns the overview index.

tools.name: ego_doctor
tools.description: Preflight the ego-browser environment: vendored runtime present, Chrome/Edge/Brave candidates, state dir, CDP/browser.json, ego-cast worker, task spaces. Run first when the browser fails to start (update, reboot, port conflict) or before a long session.

tools.name: ego_script
tools.description: Run an arbitrary `ego-browser nodejs` heredoc script in ONE invocation (same runtime/API as ego_cli: page/…locator/browser/taskSpaces/site/fetch/cdp preloaded), and return structured {ok, stdout, stderr, result, durationMs, timedOut}. Use for a full multi-step browser task as a single script.

script.description: Full JS script body; end with console.log('@@DSH_RESULT@@' + JSON.stringify({...})) — the literal @@DSH_RESULT@@ sentinel is required. (A trailing plain JSON line is accepted as a fallback, with result.fallback=true.)

timeoutMs.description: Per-run timeout in ms (default plugin grace).
